hero.title: Watch Together. Anywhere.
hero.subtitle: Synchronized video viewing with friends via Telegram

features.sync_desc: Frame-perfect playback synchronization. Everyone sees the same moment, always.
features.chat_desc: Text chat, emoji reactions, reply threads, and floating reactions while you watch.
features.voice_desc: Crystal-clear voice powered by MediaSoup SFU — up to 100 people in one room.
features.platforms_desc: YouTube, Twitch, VK, Rutube, TikTok, Twitter and many more. Direct HLS/DASH links too.
features.achievements_desc: Earn XP, level up, and unlock 10+ achievements. Show off your watch party stats.
features.rooms_desc: Create public or private rooms, invite friends by code, and control who can do what.

onboarding.step1_desc: Create your own room, browse public ones, or join by invite code. It takes seconds.
onboarding.step2_desc: Perfectly synced playback with text chat, voice chat, and 25+ supported platforms.
onboarding.step3_desc: Earn XP, level up, collect achievements, and invite friends to watch parties.
